mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, it is 75 degrees and clear under the New Moon at Badger Ridge Middle School. If you look to the West Southwest over Mount Horeb at 9:06 PM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling toward Madison for 4 minutes. The overnight low will be 59 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Police Department is inviting residents to apply for its Citizen Academy, a nine-week program covering O W I investigations and firearms education. Additionally, please note that the Military Ridge State Trail is closed between Lincoln and South Franklin Street through mid-November for bridge construction.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions, the downtown farmer's market, and trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing tomorrow.
On Sunday August 30, the Verona Police Department arrested 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison on one count of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.
Today's flavor at Culver's is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The restaurant is open until 10:00 PM, so stop by and enjoy a treat before they close for the evening.
